title: Quasi-isomorphisms are saturated and triangulation-compatible
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian]. In the homotopy category $K(\mathcal A)$ of cochain complexes, the quasi-isomorphisms form a saturated multiplicative system compatible with the triangulated structure: they satisfy two-out-of-three (including closure under retracts), and a morphism is a quasi-isomorphism exactly when its cone is acyclic. Consequently the localization $Q:K(\mathcal A)\to D(\mathcal A)$ is the localization required in Situation Tag 05S8 [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], with $K(\mathcal A)$ and $D(\mathcal A)$ triangulated [def-weil-triangulated-category].
